rows.label: Aeolak Blueprint
rows.note: Tier 5 only (enemy level 110-115); Hespar rolls a separate bounty table, so check the reward preview before accepting

conditions: Lower tiers never drop the main blueprint, and it cannot be traded.
Failing the bounty's objective forfeits everything, plumes included.
Play the Tier 5 bounty on Void Flood or Void Cascade so that mission's normal rotation table also rolls.

groups.meta: 4.23% A / 4.60% B / 8.33% C; every rotation pays since the Narin update
conditions: Rotates AABC; since the Narin update A and B also drop parts, so don't wait for an all-C loop.
Fails at 100% corruption if the 2m30s countdown expires before extraction opens; seal ruptures early.
Extraction is manual: hold the elevator panel, and coordinate with the squad since a partial group in the lift can pull everyone out mid-rotation.
bonuses: Titania's Razorwing grabs floating Vitoplast without parkour; Rotation C is about 10 minutes solo with her. Zephyr is the runner-up.
Skittergirl steals Vitoplast from players who stray from the squad; kill her to get it back.

conditions: Same AABC rotation as Void Flood.
bonuses: The Narin update put Narin parts and Entropic Kuva on this same table, so public squads should be easier to find.
